. I was 33 years old working in the private sector and after yet another bad car buying experience I was fed up! I wanted to start a different kind of car company built on Christian ethics and morals. Our faith guides us, but I tell people all of the time that we love Jesus and set out to honor Him, but that doesn't mean your car will last forever! Lol! What it means is that we are always going to be honest and transparent with you. I am a Veteran and a patriot and believe in old fashioned business practices. I wanted to set out to provide a high quality, used car without all of the dealer tricks and deception. What I found is that other people wanted that too! By being honest and transparent we built our small business into the largest independent dealership in the state. In late 2018 my wife and I sold our business in Indiana and moved to Florida with the dreams of doing the same model here while being closer to our family. We did it with the Lord’s wisdom and help! Our company is called Trade Guru because we specialize in new car trade-ins. If you don't know the difference between a new car trade-in and a normal car at the auction, it is a very important distinction. We look for cars that people trade in just because they want a new one not because there's something wrong with it. We don't buy from independent dealers who are trying to hide their sins and pawn their broken cars off onto other people. Florida is full of nice, low mileage, one owner cars and that's what we specialize in. We mostly buy from local, high-line, luxury car dealerships. These are the cars that people paid 40k to 90k for and have been taken care. That's what we want to give you as the second owner! We look for one to two owner vehicles with documented service histories and CarFax's. We allow you to take our cars to a mechanic to help you make a wise decision for you and your family. We price our cars using Kelly blue book and J.D. Power. If you look at CarGuru’s website, all of our cars are beyond fair deals, as they call them! We have our own experienced technicians, interior upholstery workers, body workers, as well as tire and brake workers to help service your car’s needs. You name it and we can do it all. One of the best values I can offer my customers is a drastically discounted labor rate for the life of the car. That means that when you buy a car from me, if anything were to happen, whether it be brakes or even a motor, you will pay a fraction of the labor cost of any shop in town. In addition to this savings, we will not markup the price on any of the parts your car needs, market price only! That could save you thousands of dollars during the life of your car. Our service department is not a for-profit service department, it is to serve our customers and maintain our cars to keep you coming back and buying from us in the future. We go through our cars and make sure we're selling a good product, but at the end of the day these are machines and sometimes unforeseen things happen. You have my word that I will personally answer your call, work to be at peace with you and find a solution to keep you on the road! Most dealers just say, “Hey, you bought the car as is. Have a great day.” That's not who I am! We are easy to deal with and family owned and operated. You will feel comfortable and at ease the minute you walk in the door, I guarantee! You will NEVER be lied to, I guarantee! You will NEVER be overcharged, I guarantee that also! Please give us a chance to prove that we are a great resource for high-quality, cash cars! This is the handbuilt AMG 4.0L biturbo V8 in its most exclusive, blacked-out form. The Classic Red leather with a leather-topped dashboard gives the interior real drama, while an AMG Performance steering wheel in microfiber and carbon fiber and a heated steering wheel anchor the cabin. It's a G63 optioned to stand out rather than blend in, from its matte paint to its red-and-black interior.

The G-Class body upright, unmistakable, and as capable as it is commanding needs no introduction.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Powered by a commanding 6.2L V8 engine and a smooth 10 speed automatic transmission, this SUV delivers an unforgettable performance. It comes with a completely clean CARFAX and has had only one owner, meaning it has been cared for with the highest standards. From its bold black exterior to the beautiful 22 inch alloy wheels, this vehicle makes a powerful statement wherever you go.Step inside and discover a cabin built for ultimate relaxation. The power open and close doors welcome you into a world of comfort, complete with premium wood accents and a massive power panoramic sunroof that fills the space with natural light. The front seats do it all: they are heated, ventilated, and feature a power massage setting to melt away stress on long trips. Plus, with a spacious third row and full all weather floor mats covering every single row, your family and your interior are fully protected from the elements.The technology in this Escalade feels like a look into the future. Music lovers will be amazed by the AKG Studio Reference 36 speaker audio system, which delivers concert quality sound. For the driver, a customizable Heads Up Display projects your speed and directions directly onto the windshield, while wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected without any messy cords.When it comes to the ride, this SUV feels like driving on a cloud. Land Rover Riverside is delighted to showcase this Certified Pre-Owned 2023 Land Rover Range Rover SE SWB, dressed in a sophisticated Santorini Black exterior with an Ebony Perforated Windsor Leather interior and with just 44,929 miles to its name. This exceptional luxury SUV is a testament to Land Rover's uncompromising blend of refinement, cutting-edge technology, and legendary capability.
The Range Rover SE SWB embodies modern luxury with its clean, commanding silhouette and unmistakable presence. Finished in Santorini Black and enhanced by the striking Shadow Exterior Pack, 22-inch Style 7023 Wheels, and Black Brake Calipers, this Range Rover projects confidence from every angle. Its timeless design is complemented by premium details that elevate both style and performance.

Step inside and the Ebony Perforated Windsor Leather interior welcomes you with world-class craftsmanship and exceptional comfort. The cabin is beautifully appointed with an Ebony Morzine Headlining and elegant Gloss Grand Black Veneer, creating an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. The 20-way Heated and Ventilated Electric Front Seats with Power Reclining Heated and Ventilated Rear Seats ensure first-class comfort for every passenger, while the premium materials throughout the cabin reflect Land Rover's dedication to luxury.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this flagship SUV is a 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six Mild Hybrid (MHEV) gasoline engine, producing 395 horsepower and 406 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a refined 8-speed automatic transmission and Land Rover's renowned Intelligent All-Wheel Drive system, this powertrain delivers effortless acceleration, exceptional refinement, and remarkable capability both on and off the road.

Key Features:

• Technology Pack: A comprehensive suite of advanced driver assistance and connectivity features designed to enhance convenience, safety, and the overall driving experience.

• 20-Way Heated & Ventilated Electric Front Seats with Power Reclining Heated & Ventilated Rear Seats: Delivering outstanding comfort and luxury for both front and rear passengers.

• Shadow Exterior Pack: Adding distinctive black exterior accents that complement the Range Rover's modern and sophisticated styling.

• Park Assist: Helping simplify parking maneuvers with intelligent automated steering assistance in suitable parking spaces.

• 22-Inch Style 7023 Wheels: Providing a bold appearance while enhancing the vehicle's premium road presence.

• Premium Interior Protection & Storage Pack: Offering practical storage solutions and interior protection to help preserve the cabin's luxurious condition.

This 2023 Land Rover Range Rover SE SWB is far more than just a luxury SUV, it is the embodiment of Land Rover's commitment to exceptional craftsmanship, advanced innovation, and effortless capability. Available at Land Rover Riverside, this Certified Pre-Owned Range Rover offers an extraordinary opportunity to experience flagship British luxury at its finest.



Land Rover Riverside is a member of the indiGO Auto Group. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
